required_outcomes: Recognises that today, Monday 8 September, is the visit date the tenant relayed (event 025), the 10 to 12 slot has passed, and nothing in the record yet says whether the engineer attended or what was done.

Gets the outcome: asks Keystone Compliance for the job report (attended or not, work done, any invoice) and/or checks with the tenant whether the visit happened and the oven now heats, or sets a follow-up for later today or tomorrow morning to do so.
Does not record the work as done or close the job without that evidence.
acceptable_alternatives: Waiting until the end of the day before contacting anyone, provided a dated follow-up is set for that check.
positive_behaviours: Notes that 8 September was relayed by the tenant (event 025), not confirmed by Keystone in writing, so a missed visit is possible and worth checking early.
red_flags: Escalating to a human with no sign that anything went wrong.
Rebooking or treating it as a missed appointment before anyone says the engineer did not come.
prohibited_actions: Recording a completed work result or an invoice amount, or closing the job, with no report from Keystone or the tenant.
critical_failures: Telling the landlord the oven is fixed, or closing the request, on no evidence.
